how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form from the official website at www.uhf.ac.in.
Fill out the application form completely in all respects.
Attach self-attested copies of relevant certificates in support of essential qualification along with the application form.

Attach the application fee in the shape of IPO/Bank Draft drawn on State Bank of India/UCO Bank Nauni (Solan)-173230 (HP) payable to the Comptroller, Dr. Y.S. Parmar University of Horticulture & Forestry, Nauni (Solan).
Ensure candidates claiming fee concession attach the relevant category certificate.

Ensure the application reaches the office latest by 28.10.2026 till 05:00 PM.
important_instructions: The position is purely temporary, non-sanctioned, and co-terminus with the project. The candidate must write his/her telephone/mobile number and e-mail ID in the application form. The candidate having marks issued in the form of CGPA/OGPA should attach approved conversion table/formula along with the application form. No separate letter for interview will be issued. Candidates must appear for interview/evaluation of documents at their own expenses. The engagement will be made on a service contract agreement on judicial stamp paper at the time of joining. Applicants already working in any project should send their application through their PI/HOD. Incomplete applications or those received after the last date will not be entertained. The university reserves the right not to fill up any or all of the positions without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q1. What is YSP UHF Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by Dr Y S Parmar University of Horticulture and Forestry for filling 1 temporary Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position under the Department of Food Science and Technology.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under YSP UHF JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 28 October 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for YSP UHF JRF?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.Sc. in Horticulture Post Harvest Management, Post Harvest Technology, Food Technology, Food Science and Technology, Food Processing Technology, or Fruit Science.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for YSP UHF JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a minimum of 18 years and not more than 45 years of age, with age relaxation applicable for reserved categories as per H.P. Government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for YSP UHF JRF?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500 for General candidates and Rs. 200 for Reserved Category candidates, payable via IPO or Bank Draft.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for YSP UHF Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application form from the official website, fill it out completely, attach required documents and fee draft, and submit it offline to the Directorate of Research by post or in person.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for YSP UHF JRF?
faq.answer: Selection is based on document evaluation and an interview scheduled on 2 November 2026 at 11:00 AM onwards.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for YSP UHF JRF?
faq.answer: The JRF post carries a fixed pay of Rs. 25,000 per month for the 1st and 2nd year, followed by Rs. 37,000 per month on promotion to SRF for the 3rd year.

faq.question: Q10. When and where will the interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview will be held on 2 November 2026 from 11:00 AM onwards in the office chamber of Director of Research, Directorate of Research, Dr. Y.S. Parmar University of Horticulture & Forestry, Nauni (Solan).
